Class Game

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.GameDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

The core game class. Inherit this class, create a new instance of this class and call Run() to start the game.

public class Game

Remarks

Main Game loop call order:

  • LoadContent() - Called once.
  • BeginRun() - Called once.
  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) - Called every frame with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo)- Called every frame.
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • EndRun() - Called once.
  • UnloadContent() - Called once.
Fixed Game loop call order:
  • LoadContent() - Called once.
  • BeginRun() - Called once.
  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) - Called every frame with variable timing.
  • FixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) - Called in a fixed interval with fixed timing.
  • InterpolateFixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, float) - Called every frame with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • EndRun() - Called once.
  • UnloadContent() - Called once.

CurrentGameInstance

Gets the singleton instance of the current game.

public static Game CurrentGameInstance { get; }

Property Value

Game

Remarks

This property is initialized automatically in the constructor. You need to create a game instance before accessing this property. If it is accessed before being set, a NullReferenceException will be thrown. You should only ever create one game instance per application, but in case you create multiple, this property will always point to the last created game instance.

DebugMode

Property Value

bool

FixedPhysicsEnabled

Gets whether the fixed physics update system is enabled.

public bool FixedPhysicsEnabled { get; }

Property Value

bool

Remarks

When true, the fixed update functions will be called at the FixedPhysicsFramerate. Fixed Update call order:

  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) with variable timing.
  • FixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) with fixed timing.
  • InterpolateFixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, float) with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo)
Unlocked Update call order:
  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo)

FixedPhysicsFramerate

Gets the target framerate for fixed physics updates.

public int FixedPhysicsFramerate { get; }

Property Value

int

Remarks

This value determines how many physics updates will be performed per second. Higher values provide more accurate physics but require more processing power.

FixedPhysicsTimestep

Gets the time interval in seconds between fixed physics updates.

public float FixedPhysicsTimestep { get; }

Property Value

float

Remarks

This value is calculated as 1.0 / FixedPhysicsFramerate and represents the duration of each physics step in seconds.
